    .sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right));
  const cacheKey = method === 'GET'
    ? `${text(request && request.url)}\n${headerEntries.map(([name, value]) => `${name}:${value}`).join('\n')}`
    : '';
  const cached = cacheKey ? TEXT_RESPONSE_CACHE.get(cacheKey) : null;
  if (cached && Date.now() - cached.updatedAt < TEXT_RESPONSE_CACHE_MS) return cached.value;
  const response = await reader.http.fetch({ timeoutMs: 30000, ...request });
  const status = integer(response && response.status, 0);
  if (status < 200 || status >= 400) throw new Error(`请求失败：HTTP ${status || 'unknown'}`);
  const value = { body: text(response && response.body), url: text(response && response.url) || request.url,
    headers: object(response && response.headers) };
  if (cacheKey) {
    if (TEXT_RESPONSE_CACHE.size >= 32) TEXT_RESPONSE_CACHE.delete(TEXT_RESPONSE_CACHE.keys().next().value);
    TEXT_RESPONSE_CACHE.set(cacheKey, { updatedAt: Date.now(), value });
  }
  return value;
}

function htmlParseRequest(html, selector, value = 'text', attribute = '', all = false, limit = 256) {
  const request = { html: text(html), selector: text(selector).replace(/:containsData\(/gi, ':contains('),
    value, all, limit };
  if (attribute) request.attribute = attribute;
  return request;
}

function normalizeHtmlValue(result, value, all) {
  const normalize = item => value === 'text' ? decodeHtmlEntities(item) : text(item);
  if (all) return Array.isArray(result) ? result.map(normalize).filter(Boolean) : [];
  return normalize(result);
}

async function htmlValues(requests) {
  const normalized = requests.map(request => htmlParseRequest(request.html, request.selector,
    request.value || 'text', request.attribute || '', request.all === true,
    Number.isInteger(request.limit) ? request.limit : 256));
  const raw = [];
  if (reader.html && typeof reader.html.parseBatch === 'function') {
    try {
      let chunk = [];
      let chunkBytes = 0;
      const flush = async () => {
        if (chunk.length === 0) return;
        const values = await reader.html.parseBatch({ requests: chunk });
        if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length !== chunk.length) throw new Error('HTML 批量解析返回数量不匹配');
        raw.push(...values);
        chunk = [];
        chunkBytes = 0;
      };
      for (const request of normalized) {
        const requestBytes = request.html.length * 2;
        if (chunk.length >= 400 || (chunk.length > 0 && chunkBytes + requestBytes > 12 * 1024 * 1024)) await flush();
        chunk.push(request);
        chunkBytes += requestBytes;
      }
      await flush();
    } catch (_error) {
      raw.length = 0;
    }
  }
  if (raw.length !== normalized.length) {
    raw.length = 0;
    for (const request of normalized) raw.push(await reader.html.parse(request));
  }
  return raw.map((value, index) => normalizeHtmlValue(value, normalized[index].value, normalized[index].all));
}

async function htmlValue(html, selector, value = 'text', attribute = '', all = false, limit = 256) {
  return (await htmlValues([{ html, selector, value, attribute, all, limit }]))[0];
}

async function firstAttribute(html, selector, attributes) {
  for (const attribute of attributes) {
    const value = await htmlValue(html, selector, 'attribute', attribute, false, 1);
    if (value) return value;
  }
  return '';
}

function formBody(entries) {
  return Object.entries(entries).map(([key, value]) =>
    `${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(value === undefined ? '' : String(value))}`).join('&');
}

function decodeHtmlEntities(value) {
  let result = text(value);
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass += 1) {
    const decoded = result
      .replace(/&#x([0-9a-f]+);?/gi, (_match, digits) => {
        const codePoint = Number.parseInt(digits, 16);
        try { return codePoint > 0 && codePoint <= 0x10ffff ? String.fromCodePoint(codePoint) : _match; }
        catch (_error) { return _match; }
      })
      .replace(/&#([0-9]+);?/g, (_match, digits) => {
        const codePoint = Number.parseInt(digits, 10);
        try { return codePoint > 0 && codePoint <= 0x10ffff ? String.fromCodePoint(codePoint) : _match; }
        catch (_error) { return _match; }
      })
      .replace(/ ?/gi, ' ').replace(/"?/gi, '"').replace(/'?|'?/gi, "'")
      .replace(/<?/gi, '<').replace(/>?/gi, '>').replace(/&?/gi, '&');
    if (decoded === result) break;
    result = decoded;
  }
  return result;
}

function normalizedTypes(values) {
  const result = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const value of Array.isArray(values) ? values : []) {
    const item = decodeHtmlEntities(value).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 128);
    if (!item || seen.has(item)) continue;
    seen.add(item);
    result.push(item);
    if (result.length >= 32) break;
  }
  return result;
}

function stripHtml(value) {
  return decodeHtmlEntities(text(value).replace(/<br\s*\/?\s*>/gi, '\n').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' '))
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

function htmlAttribute(fragment, name) {
  const source = text(fragment);
  let match = source.match(new RegExp(`\\b${name}\\s*=\\s*"([^"]*)"`, 'i'));
  if (match) return match[1].replace(/&/gi, '&');
  match = source.match(new RegExp(`\\b${name}\\s*=\\s*'([^']*)'`, 'i'));
  if (match) return match[1].replace(/&/gi, '&');
  match = source.match(new RegExp(`\\b${name}\\s*=\\s*([^\\s>]+)`, 'i'));
  return match ? match[1].replace(/&/gi, '&') : '';
}

function lastUrlSegment(value, prefix = '') {
  const raw = text(value).replace(/\/$/, '');
  if (prefix) {
    const marker = `/${text(prefix).replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '')}/`;
    const index = raw.indexOf(marker);
    if (index >= 0) return decodeIdentity(raw.slice(index + marker.length).split(/[/?#]/)[0]);
  }
  return decodeIdentity(raw.split(/[/?#]/).filter(Boolean).pop() || '');
}

async function htmlTagItems(url, selector, options = {}) {
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url, method: 'GET', headers: object(options.headers).Accept ? options.headers : requestHeaders(url) });
  const rows = await htmlValue(loaded.body, selector, 'outerHTML', '', true, 512);
  const seen = new Set();
  const result = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const href = htmlAttribute(row, 'href');
    const requiredHrefParts = Array.isArray(options.hrefContains) ? options.hrefContains.map(text).filter(Boolean) : [];
    if (requiredHrefParts.length > 0 && !requiredHrefParts.some(part => href.includes(part))) continue;
    const rawKey = options.attribute ? htmlAttribute(row, options.attribute) :
      lastUrlSegment(href, options.prefix || '');
    const title = categoryTitle(row);
    if (options.excludeZeroCount === true && /\(\s*0\s*\)\s*$/.test(title)) continue;
    if (Array.isArray(options.excludeTitles) && options.excludeTitles.map(text).includes(title)) continue;
    const key = options.useTitle ? title : rawKey;
    if (!key || !title || seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    result.push({ key: discoveryKey('tag', key), title, group: options.group || '分类' });
  }
  return result;
}

}

async function parseMadaraList(source, loaded) {

  }
  const books = [];
  for (const row of rows) {

      '.tab-summary h3, .tab-summary h4, .item-summary h3, .item-summary h4, .manga-name, .post-title'),

      ['data-src', 'data-lazy-src', 'src']);

    });

}

async function search(input) {
  const source = sourceForInput(input);
  const runtime = runtimeSource(source);
  const filter = discoveryFilter(input);
  if (!SUPPORTED_ENGINES.includes(runtime.engine)) throw new Error(`暂不支持解析引擎：${runtime.engine}`);
  if (runtime.engine === 'MadaraParser' && configured(source, 'withoutAjax', false) === true) {
    return searchMadaraWithoutAjax(source, input);
  }
  if (runtime.engine === 'MangaReaderParser') return searchMangaReader(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'OneMangaParser') return searchOneManga(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ZeistMangaParser') return searchZeist(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'MangaBallParser') return searchMangaBall(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'HotComicsParser') return searchHotComics(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'WeebDexParser') return searchWeebDex(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'PizzaReaderParser') return searchPizzaReader(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'WebtoonsParser') return searchWebtoons(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'KeyoappParser') return searchKeyoapp(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GalleryAdultsParser') return searchGalleryAdults(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GalleryParser') return searchGallery(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'SinmhParser') return searchSinmh(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GuyaParser') return searchGuya(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'SimpleHtmlParser') return searchSimpleHtml(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'BaoziParser') return searchBaozi(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ComickParser') return searchComick(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ZaimanhuaParser') return searchZaimanhua(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'NhentaiParser') return searchNhentai(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GodaParser') return searchGoda(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ProjectSukiParser') return searchProjectSuki(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'MangaDexParser') return searchMangaDex(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'KomiicParser') return searchKomiic(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'Mh1234Parser') return searchMh1234(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'HComicParser') return searchHComic(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'AcgxmhParser') return searchAcgxmh(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'FoolSlideParser') return searchFoolSlide(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'Manga18Parser') return searchManga18(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GattsuParser') return searchGattsu(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'MadthemeParser') return searchMadtheme(source, input);
  const page = Math.max(0, integer(input && input.page, 1) - 1);
  const keyword = text(input && input.keyword);
  const root = sourceRoot(source);
  const url = `${root}wp-admin/admin-ajax.php`;
  const values = {
    action: 'madara_load_more',
    page,
    template: 'madara-core/content/content-search',
    'vars[s]': keyword,
    'vars[paged]': page + 1,
    'vars[template]': 'search',
    'vars[meta_query][0][relation]': 'AND',
    'vars[meta_query][relation]': 'AND',
    'vars[post_type]': 'wp-manga',
    'vars[post_status]': 'publish',
    'vars[manga_archives_item_layout]': 'default',
    'vars[orderby]': ''
  };
  if (filter.kind === 'tag') {
    values['vars[tax_query][0][taxonomy]'] = 'wp-manga-genre';
    values['vars[tax_query][0][field]'] = 'slug';
    values['vars[tax_query][0][terms][0]'] = filter.value;
    values['vars[tax_query][0][operator]'] = 'IN';
    values['vars[tax_query][relation]'] = 'AND';
  }
  if (filter.kind === 'state') {
    values['vars[meta_query][0][0][key]'] = '_wp_manga_status';
    values['vars[meta_query][0][0][compare]'] = 'IN';
    values['vars[meta_query][0][0][value][0]'] = filter.value === 'completed' ? 'end' :
      filter.value === 'cancelled' ? 'canceled' : filter.value === 'hiatus' ? 'on-hold' :
        filter.value === 'upcoming' ? 'upcoming' : 'on-going';
  }
  if (filter.kind === 'rating') {
    values['vars[meta_query][0][1][key]'] = 'manga_adult_content';
    values['vars[meta_query][0][1][value]'] = filter.value === 'adult' ?
      'a:1:{i:0;s:3:"yes";}' : '';
  }
  const sort = filter.kind === 'sort' ? filter.value : 'updated';
  if (sort === 'popularity') {
    values['vars[meta_key]'] = '_wp_manga_views'; values['vars[orderby]'] = 'meta_value_num';
    values['vars[order]'] = 'desc';
  } else if (sort === 'updated') {
    values['vars[meta_key]'] = '_latest_update'; values['vars[orderby]'] = 'meta_value_num';
    values['vars[order]'] = 'desc';
  } else if (sort === 'newest') {
    values['vars[orderby]'] = 'date'; values['vars[order]'] = 'desc';
  } else if (sort === 'alphabetical') {
    values['vars[orderby]'] = 'post_title'; values['vars[order]'] = 'asc';
  } else if (sort === 'rating') {
    values['vars[meta_query][0][query_avarage_reviews][key]'] = '_manga_avarage_reviews';
    values['vars[meta_query][0][query_total_reviews][key]'] = '_manga_total_votes';
    values['vars[orderby][query_avarage_reviews]'] = 'DESC';
    values['vars[orderby][query_total_reviews]'] = 'DESC';
  }
  const loaded = await fetchText({
    url,
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { ...requestHeaders(root),
      'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
      'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
    body: formBody(values)
  });
  const books = await parseMadaraList(source, loaded);
  if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') books.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
  return books;
}

async function searchMadaraWithoutAjax(source, input) {
  const page = Math.max(1, integer(input && input.page, 1));
  const keyword = text(input && input.keyword);
  const filter = discoveryFilter(input);
  const root = sourceRoot(source).replace(/\/$/, '');
  const customPaths = object(runtimeConfig(source).madaraBrowsePaths);
  let customPattern = text(customPaths[`${filter.kind}:${filter.value}`]) || text(runtimeConfig(source).madaraBrowsePath);
  if (keyword && text(runtimeConfig(source).madaraSearchPath)) customPattern = text(runtimeConfig(source).madaraSearchPath);
  else if (!keyword && filter.kind === 'tag' && text(runtimeConfig(source).madaraTagPath)) {
    customPattern = text(runtimeConfig(source).madaraTagPath);
  }
  if (customPattern) {
    const customPath = templatePath(customPattern, { page, pagePath: page > 1 ? `page/${page}/` : '',
      plainPage: page > 1 ? String(page) : '', query: encodeURIComponent(keyword), tag: encodeURIComponent(filter.value || '') });
    const customUrl = absoluteUrl(customPath, `${root}/`);
    const customLoaded = await fetchText({ url: customUrl, method: 'GET', headers: requestHeaders(sourceRoot(source)) });
    const customBooks = await parseMadaraList(source, customLoaded);
    if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') customBooks.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
    return customBooks;
  }
  const pagePath = page > 1 ? `/page/${page}` : '';
  const params = { s: keyword, post_type: 'wp-manga' };
  if (filter.kind === 'tag') params['genre[]'] = filter.value;
  if (filter.kind === 'state') params['status[]'] = filter.value === 'completed' ? 'end' :
    filter.value === 'cancelled' ? 'canceled' : filter.value === 'hiatus' ? 'on-hold' :
      filter.value === 'upcoming' ? 'upcoming' : 'on-going';
  if (filter.kind === 'rating') params.adult = filter.value === 'adult' ? '1' : '0';
  const sort = filter.kind === 'sort' ? filter.value : 'updated';
  params.m_orderby = sort === 'popularity' ? 'views' : sort === 'newest' ? 'new-manga' :
    sort === 'alphabetical' ? 'alphabet' : sort === 'rating' ? 'rating' : 'latest';
  const url = `${root}${pagePath}/?${formBody(params)}`;
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url, method: 'GET', headers: requestHeaders(sourceRoot(source)) });
  const books = await parseMadaraList(source, loaded);
  if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') books.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
  return books;
}

function jsonText(value) {
  return text(value && typeof value === 'object' && '$t' in value ? value.$t : value);
}

function zeistAlternateLink(entry) {
  const links = Array.isArray(entry && entry.link) ? entry.link : [];
  return text((links.find(link => link && link.rel === 'alternate') || {}).href);
}

function zeistCover(entry) {
  const thumbnail = object(entry && entry['media$thumbnail']);
  if (text(thumbnail.url)) return text(thumbnail.url).replace(/\/s[^/]+-c\//, '/w600/')
    .replace(/=s[^=]+-c(?:-rw)?$/, '=w600');
  const content = jsonText(entry && entry.content);
  const match = content.match(/<img[^>]+src=["']([^"']+)/i);
  return match ? match[1] : '';
}

async function searchZeist(source, input) {
  const page = Math.max(1, integer(input && input.page, 1));
  const pageSize = Math.max(1, integer(configured(source, 'maxMangaResults', 20), 20));
  const filter = discoveryFilter(input);
  const defaultCategory = configured(source, 'mangaCategory', 'Series');
  const category = filter.kind === 'tag' ? filter.value : filter.kind === 'state' ?
    (filter.value === 'completed' ? configured(source, 'sateFinished', 'Completed') :
      filter.value === 'cancelled' ? configured(source, 'sateAbandoned', 'Cancelled') :
        configured(source, 'sateOngoing', 'Ongoing')) : defaultCategory;
  const start = pageSize * (page - 1) + 1;
  const query = text(input && input.keyword);
  const suffix = query ? `&q=label:${encodeURIComponent(defaultCategory)}+${encodeURIComponent(query)}` : '';
  const root = sourceRoot(source);
  const url = `${root}feeds/posts/default/-/${encodeURIComponent(category)}` +
    `?alt=json&orderby=published&max-results=${pageSize + 1}&start-index=${start}${suffix}`;
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url, method: 'GET', headers: requestHeaders(root) });
  let payload;
  try { payload = JSON.parse(loaded.body); } catch (_error) { throw new Error('Zeist 漫画列表返回了无效 JSON'); }
  const entries = Array.isArray(payload && payload.feed && payload.feed.entry) ? payload.feed.entry : [];
  const books = entries.map(entry => {
    const urlValue = zeistAlternateLink(entry);
    if (!urlValue) return null;
    return {
      bookKey: bookKey(source, urlValue), sourceKey: sourceKey(source), sourceName: source.title,
      title: jsonText(entry.title), author: '', intro: source.adult ? '成人漫画' : '',
      coverUrl: zeistCover(entry), bookUrl: urlValue,
      kind: source.adult ? '成人漫画' : '漫画', types: source.adult ? ['成人漫画'] : ['漫画'],
      mediaType: 'comic'
    };
  }).filter(Boolean);
  if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') books.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
  return books;
}

async function mangaBallCsrf(source) {
  const baseUrl = 'https://mangaball.net/';
  try { await Promise.resolve(reader.cookie.set(baseUrl, 'show18PlusContent=true')); } catch (_error) {}
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url: baseUrl, method: 'GET', headers: requestHeaders(baseUrl) });
  const csrf = await htmlValue(loaded.body, 'meta[name="csrf-token"]', 'attribute', 'content', false, 1);
  if (!csrf) throw new Error('Manga Ball 页面没有返回 CSRF token');
  return csrf;
}

async function mangaBallApi(source, endpoint, values) {
  const csrf = await mangaBallCsrf(source);
  const url = `https://mangaball.net${endpoint}`;
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url, method: 'POST', body: formBody(values), headers: {
    ...requestHeaders('https://mangaball.net/'),
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
    'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrf
  } });
  try { return JSON.parse(loaded.body); } catch (_error) { throw new Error('Manga Ball 接口返回了无效 JSON'); }
}

function mangaBallSlug(value) {
  const raw = text(value);
  const match = raw.match(/\/title-detail\/([^/?#]+)/i);
  return match ? match[1] : raw.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
}

async function searchMangaBall(source, input) {
  const keyword = text(input && input.keyword);
  const page = Math.max(1, integer(input && input.page, 1));
  const filter = discoveryFilter(input);
  const languages = Array.isArray(runtimeConfig(source).siteLanguages)
    ? runtimeConfig(source).siteLanguages : [source.language];
  const values = {
    search_input: keyword,
    'filters[sort]': filter.kind === 'sort' ? ({ updated: 'updated_chapters_desc', popularity: 'views_desc',
      newest: 'created_at_desc', alphabetical: 'name_asc', alphabetical_desc: 'name_desc' }[filter.value] ||
      'updated_chapters_desc') : 'updated_chapters_desc',
    'filters[page]': page,
    'filters[tag_included_mode]': 'and',
    'filters[tag_excluded_mode]': 'or',
    'filters[contentRating]': 'any',
    'filters[demographic]': filter.kind === 'demographic' ? filter.value : 'any',
    'filters[person]': 'any',
    'filters[publicationYear]': '',
    'filters[publicationStatus]': filter.kind === 'state' ? filter.value : 'any'
  };
  const includedTag = filter.kind === 'tag' ? filter.value :
    filter.kind === 'type' ? MANGABALL_TYPE_TAGS[filter.value] : '';
  if (includedTag) values['filters[tag_included_ids][0]'] = includedTag;
  languages.forEach((language, index) => { values[`filters[translatedLanguage][${index}]`] = language; });
  const payload = await mangaBallApi(source, '/api/v1/title/search-advanced/', values);
  const rows = Array.isArray(payload && payload.data) ? payload.data : [];
  const books = rows.map(item => {
    const slug = mangaBallSlug(item && item.url);

    return {
      bookKey: bookKey(source, bookUrl), sourceKey: sourceKey(source), sourceName: source.title,
      title: text(item && (item.name || item.title)), author: '', intro: source.adult ? '成人漫画' : '',
      coverUrl: absoluteUrl(item && (item.cover || item.img), 'https://mangaball.net/'),
      bookUrl, kind: source.adult ? '成人漫画' : '漫画',
      types: source.adult ? ['成人漫画'] : ['漫画'], mediaType: 'comic'
    };
  }).filter(item => item && item.title);
  if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') books.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
  return books;
}

function parseWeebDexBook(source, item) {
  const id = text(item && item.id);
  const title = text(item && item.title);
  if (!id || !title) return null;
  const relationships = object(item.relationships);
  const cover = object(relationships.cover);
  const coverUrl = cover.id && cover.ext ? `https://weebdex.org/covers/${id}/${cover.id}${cover.ext}` : '';
  const tags = Array.isArray(relationships.tags) ? relationships.tags.map(tag => text(tag && tag.name)).filter(Boolean) : [];
  const bookUrl = `https://weebdex.org/manga/${id}`;
  return {
    bookKey: bookKey(source, bookUrl), sourceKey: sourceKey(source), sourceName: source.title,
    title, author: '', intro: text(item.description), coverUrl, bookUrl,
    kind: tags.join(' · ') || (source.adult ? '成人漫画' : '漫画'), types: tags,
    mediaType: 'comic'
  };
}

async function fetchJsonRequest(url, referer, extraHeaders = {}) {
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url, method: 'GET', headers: { ...requestHeaders(referer), ...object(extraHeaders) } });
  try { return JSON.parse(loaded.body); } catch (_error) { throw new Error('漫画接口返回了无效 JSON'); }
}

async function komiicGraphql(source, query, operationName, variables) {
  const root = sourceRoot(source);
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url: `${root}api/query`, method: 'POST', headers: {
    ...sourceRequestHeaders(source, root), Accept: 'application/json, text/plain, */*', Origin: root.replace(/\/$/, ''),
    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  }, body: JSON.stringify({ operationName, variables: object(variables), query }) });
  let payload;
  try { payload = JSON.parse(loaded.body); } catch (_error) { throw new Error('Komiic 接口返回了无效 JSON'); }
  const errors = Array.isArray(payload && payload.errors) ? payload.errors : [];
  if (errors.length > 0) throw new Error(`Komiic 接口错误：${text(errors[0] && errors[0].message) || '未知错误'}`);
  const data = object(payload && payload.data);
  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) throw new Error('Komiic 接口没有返回数据');
  return data;
}

async function searchWeebDex(source, input) {
  const page = Math.max(1, integer(input && input.page, 1));
  const keyword = text(input && input.keyword);
  const filter = discoveryFilter(input);
  const sort = filter.kind === 'sort' ? ({ updated: 'updatedAt', popularity: 'views', newest: 'createdAt',
    alphabetical: 'title', rating: 'rating' }[filter.value] || 'updatedAt') : 'updatedAt';
  let url = 'https://api.weebdex.org/manga?limit=42' + `&page=${page}` +
    (keyword ? `&sort=relevance&title=${encodeURIComponent(keyword)}` : `&sort=${sort}`);
  if (filter.kind === 'tag') url += `&tag=${encodeURIComponent(filter.value)}`;
  if (filter.kind === 'state') url += `&status=${encodeURIComponent(filter.value)}`;
  const payload = await fetchJsonRequest(url, 'https://weebdex.org/');
  const rows = Array.isArray(payload && payload.data) ? payload.data : [];
  const books = rows.map(item => parseWeebDexBook(source, item)).filter(Boolean);
  if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') books.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
  return books;
}

function pizzaBook(source, item) {
  const rawUrl = text(item && item.url);
  const title = text(item && item.title);
  if (!rawUrl || !title) return null;
  const bookUrl = /^https?:\/\//i.test(rawUrl) ? rawUrl :
    absoluteUrl(`/api${rawUrl.startsWith('/') ? rawUrl : `/${rawUrl}`}`, sourceRoot(source));
  const genres = Array.isArray(item.genres) ? item.genres.map(genre =>
    text(typeof genre === 'string' ? genre : genre && (genre.name || genre.title))).filter(Boolean) : [];
  return {
    bookKey: bookKey(source, bookUrl), sourceKey: sourceKey(source), sourceName: source.title,
    title, author: text(item.author), intro: text(item.description),
    coverUrl: absoluteUrl(item.thumbnail, sourceRoot(source)), bookUrl,
    kind: genres.join(' · ') || (Number(item.adult) === 1 ? '成人漫画' : '漫画'),
    types: genres, mediaType: 'comic'
  };
}

async function searchPizzaReader(source, input) {
  const keyword = text(input && input.keyword);
  const filter = discoveryFilter(input);
  const endpoint = keyword ? `api/search/${encodeURIComponent(keyword)}` : 'api/comics';
  const payload = await fetchJsonRequest(`${sourceRoot(source)}${endpoint}`, sourceRoot(source));
  let rows = Array.isArray(payload && payload.comics) ? payload.comics : [];
  if (!keyword && filter.kind === 'state') rows = rows.filter(item =>
    text(item && item.status).toLowerCase().includes(filter.value === 'completed' ? 'complet' :
      filter.value === 'hiatus' ? 'paus' : filter.value === 'cancelled' ? 'drop' : 'corso'));
  if (!keyword && filter.kind === 'rating') rows = rows.filter(item =>
    (Number(item && item.adult) === 1) === (filter.value === 'adult'));
  const books = rows.map(item => pizzaBook(source, item)).filter(Boolean);
  if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') books.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
  return books;
}

function webtoonsLanguage(source) {
  if (source.language === 'id') return 'id';
  if (source.language === 'zh') return 'zh-hant';
  return source.language || 'en';
}

function webtoonsHeaders(referer) {
  return { ...requestHeaders(referer), 'Accept-Language': 'zh-TW,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.7' };
}

function webtoonsTitleNumber(value) {
  const match = text(value).match(/[?&]title_no=(\d+)/i);
  return match ? match[1] : '';
}

function webtoonsSerializedImageUrl(value, baseUrl) {
  const direct = absoluteUrl(value, baseUrl);
  if (!direct) return '';
  try {
    // Harmony Image and the disk cache are stricter than browsers when a CDN path contains
    // Chinese or other non-ASCII characters. URL serialisation keeps the address equivalent
    // while making it safe to hand to both loaders.
    return new URL(direct).toString();
  } catch (_error) {
    return direct;
  }
}

function htmlTagAttribute(html, tagName, attributes) {
  const tag = text(html).match(new RegExp(`<${tagName}\\b[^>]*>`, 'i'));
  if (!tag) return '';
  for (const attribute of attributes) {
    const match = tag[0].match(new RegExp(`\\b${attribute}\\s*=\\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|([^\\s>]+))`, 'i'));
    const value = match && (match[1] || match[2] || match[3]);
    if (value) return value.replace(/&/gi, '&').replace(/'/g, "'").replace(/"/gi, '"');
  }
  return '';
}

function webtoonsPageImageUrl(value, baseUrl) {
  // Kototoro keeps the parser's original Webtoons image host and sends the
  // chapter request headers with each page. Rewriting the host without those
  // headers can return the anti-hotlink placeholder instead of the comic page.
  return webtoonsSerializedImageUrl(value, baseUrl);
}

function webtoonsDirectCoverUrl(value, baseUrl) {
  const direct = webtoonsSerializedImageUrl(value, baseUrl)
    .replace(/^https?:\/\/webtoon-phinf\.pstatic\.net\//i, 'https://swebtoon-phinf.pstatic.net/');
  if (!direct) return '';
  if (/[?&]type=/i.test(direct)) {
    return direct.replace(/([?&])type=[^&#]*/i, '$1type=crop540_540');
  }
  return `${direct}${direct.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'}type=crop540_540`;
}

function webtoonsRawCoverUrls(html, baseUrl) {
  const covers = new Map();
  const anchorPattern = /<a\b[^>]*href\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)')[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/a>/gi;
  const source = text(html);
  let match;
  while ((match = anchorPattern.exec(source)) !== null) {
    const href = (match[1] || match[2] || '').replace(/&/gi, '&');
    const titleNo = webtoonsTitleNumber(href);
    if (!titleNo || covers.has(titleNo)) continue;
    const cover = htmlTagAttribute(match[0], 'img', ['data-src', 'data-url', 'src']);
    if (cover) covers.set(titleNo, webtoonsDirectCoverUrl(cover, baseUrl));
  }
  return covers;
}

async function searchWebtoons(source, input) {
  const keyword = text(input && input.keyword);
  const page = Math.max(1, integer(input && input.page, 1));
  const filter = discoveryFilter(input);
  const language = webtoonsLanguage(source);
  let url;
  if (keyword) url = `https://webtoons.com/${language}/search?keyword=${encodeURIComponent(keyword)}`;
  else if (filter.kind === 'tag' && filter.value === 'canvas') url = `https://webtoons.com/${language}/canvas`;
  else if (filter.kind === 'tag') url = `https://webtoons.com/${language}/genres/${encodeURIComponent(filter.value)}?sortOrder=MANA`;
  else url = `https://webtoons.com/${language}/ranking/${filter.value === 'rating' ? 'trending' :
    filter.value === 'updated' ? 'originals' : 'popular'}`;
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url, method: 'GET', headers: webtoonsHeaders('https://webtoons.com/') });
  const rows = await htmlValue(loaded.body,
    '.webtoon_list li a, .webtoon_scroll_list li a, .card_wrap .card_item a, .discover_lst a.discover_item',
    'outerHTML', '', true, 500);
  // Harmony's selector bridge may return an anchor outerHTML without the lazy image
  // attributes on some system versions. Keep a raw-document lookup keyed by title_no
  // so a successfully parsed title never loses the cover carried by the same card.
  const rawCoverUrls = webtoonsRawCoverUrls(loaded.body, loaded.url);
  const seen = new Set();
  const books = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const href = await firstAttribute(row, 'a', ['href']);
    const bookUrl = absoluteUrl(href, loaded.url);
    const titleNo = webtoonsTitleNumber(bookUrl);
    if (!titleNo || seen.has(titleNo)) continue;
    const title = await htmlValue(row, '.title, .card_title, .subj', 'text', '', false, 1) ||
      await firstAttribute(row, 'a', ['title']);
    if (!title) continue;
    seen.add(titleNo);
    const cover = await firstAttribute(row, 'img', ['data-src', 'data-url', 'src']) ||
      htmlTagAttribute(row, 'img', ['data-src', 'data-url', 'src']);
    const coverUrl = webtoonsDirectCoverUrl(cover, loaded.url) || rawCoverUrls.get(titleNo) || '';
    books.push({
      bookKey: bookKey(source, bookUrl), sourceKey: sourceKey(source), sourceName: source.title,
      title, author: '', intro: '', coverUrl, bookUrl,
      kind: '漫画', types: ['漫画'], mediaType: 'comic'
    });
  }
  if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') books.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
  return books.slice((page - 1) * 20, page * 20);
}

function cssBackgroundUrl(value) {
  const match = text(value).match(/url\(\s*['"]?([^'")]+)['"]?\s*\)/i);
  return match ? match[1] : '';
}

async function searchKeyoapp(source, input) {
  const keyword = text(input && input.keyword).toLocaleLowerCase();
  const filter = discoveryFilter(input);
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url: `${sourceRoot(source)}${filter.kind === 'sort' && filter.value === 'newest' ?
    'series' : 'latest'}`, method: 'GET',
    headers: requestHeaders(sourceRoot(source)) });
  let rows = await htmlValue(loaded.body, '#searched_series_page button', 'outerHTML', '', true, 500);
  if (rows.length === 0) rows = await htmlValue(loaded.body, 'div.grid > div.group', 'outerHTML', '', true, 500);
  const books = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const title = await htmlValue(row, 'h3', 'text', '', false, 1) || await firstAttribute(row, 'a', ['title']);
    if (!title || (keyword && !title.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(keyword))) continue;
    const types = await htmlValue(row, 'div.gap-1 a', 'text', '', true, 50);
    if (!keyword && filter.kind === 'tag' && !types.some(value => value.toLocaleLowerCase()
      .includes(filter.value.toLocaleLowerCase()))) continue;
    const href = await firstAttribute(row, 'a', ['href']);
    const bookUrl = absoluteUrl(href, loaded.url);
    if (!bookUrl) continue;
    let cover = await firstAttribute(row,
      'a div.bg-cover, div.bg-cover, a.bg-cover, [style*=background-image]', ['style']);
    cover = cssBackgroundUrl(cover) || await firstAttribute(row, 'img', ['data-src', 'src']);
    books.push({
      bookKey: bookKey(source, bookUrl), sourceKey: sourceKey(source), sourceName: source.title,
      title, author: '', intro: '', coverUrl: absoluteUrl(cover, loaded.url), bookUrl,
      kind: types.join(' · ') || (source.adult ? '成人漫画' : '漫画'), types, mediaType: 'comic'
    });
  }
  if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') books.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
  return books;
}

}

async function searchGuya(source, input) {
  if (Math.max(1, integer(input && input.page, 1)) > 1) return [];
  const keyword = text(input && input.keyword).toLocaleLowerCase();
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url: `${sourceRoot(source)}api/get_all_series/`, method: 'GET',
    headers: requestHeaders(sourceRoot(source)) });
  const payload = JSON.parse(loaded.body || '{}');
  const books = [];
  for (const [title, itemValue] of Object.entries(object(payload))) {
    if (keyword && !title.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(keyword)) continue;
    const item = object(itemValue);
    const slug = text(item.slug);
    if (!slug) continue;
    const bookUrl = `${sourceRoot(source)}api/series/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`;
    books.push({ bookKey: bookKey(source, bookUrl), sourceKey: sourceKey(source), sourceName: source.title,
      title, author: text(item.author), intro: text(item.description),
      coverUrl: absoluteUrl(text(item.cover), sourceRoot(source)), bookUrl,
      kind: source.adult ? '成人漫画' : '漫画', types: source.adult ? ['成人漫画'] : ['漫画'], mediaType: 'comic' });
  }
  if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') books.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
  return books;
}

function templatePath(value, replacements) {
  let output = text(value);
  for (const [key, replacement] of Object.entries(replacements)) {
    output = output.split(`{${key}}`).join(String(replacement));
  }
  return output;
}

async function searchSimpleHtml(source, input) {
  const page = Math.max(1, integer(input && input.page, 1));
  const keyword = text(input && input.keyword);
  const filter = discoveryFilter(input);
  const pagePath = page > 1 ? `page/${page}/` : '';
  let pattern = configured(source, 'listPath', '');
  if (keyword) pattern = configured(source, 'searchPath', '?s={query}&paged={page}');
  else if (text(object(runtimeConfig(source).discoveryPaths)[`${filter.kind}:${filter.value}`])) {
    pattern = object(runtimeConfig(source).discoveryPaths)[`${filter.kind}:${filter.value}`];
  }
  else if (filter.kind === 'sort' && filter.value === 'popularity') {
    pattern = configured(source, 'popularPath', pattern);
  } else if (filter.kind === 'tag') {
    pattern = configured(source, 'tagPath', `tag/{tag}/${pagePath}`);
  }
  const path = templatePath(pattern, { page, zeroPage: page - 1, pagePath, query: encodeURIComponent(keyword),
    tag: encodeURIComponent(filter.value || ''), value: encodeURIComponent(filter.value || ''),
    locale: encodeURIComponent(filter.value || '') });
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url: absoluteUrl(path, sourceRoot(source)), method: 'GET',
    headers: sourceRequestHeaders(source, sourceRoot(source)) });
  const rows = await htmlValue(loaded.body, configured(source, 'listSelector', 'article'),
    'outerHTML', '', true, 100);
  const titleAttribute = text(runtimeConfig(source).listTitleAttribute);
  const coverSelector = configured(source, 'listCoverSelector', 'img');
  const coverAttribute = text(runtimeConfig(source).listCoverAttribute);
  const fields = await htmlValues(rows.flatMap(row => [
    { html: row, selector: configured(source, 'listLinkSelector', 'a[href]'), value: 'attribute', attribute: 'href', limit: 1 },
    { html: row, selector: configured(source, 'listTitleSelector', 'h2, h3'),
      value: titleAttribute ? 'attribute' : 'text', attribute: titleAttribute, limit: 1 },
    { html: row, selector: coverSelector, value: 'attribute', attribute: 'alt', limit: 1 },
    { html: row, selector: coverSelector, value: 'attribute', attribute: coverAttribute || 'data-src', limit: 1 },
    { html: row, selector: coverSelector, value: 'attribute', attribute: 'data-src', limit: 1 },
    { html: row, selector: coverSelector, value: 'attribute', attribute: 'data-original', limit: 1 },
    { html: row, selector: coverSelector, value: 'attribute', attribute: 'data-lazy-src', limit: 1 },
    { html: row, selector: coverSelector, value: 'attribute', attribute: 'src', limit: 1 }
  ]));
  const books = [];
  const booksByUrl = new Map();
  for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index += 1) {
    const offset = index * 8;
    const href = fields[offset];
    const bookUrl = absoluteUrl(href, loaded.url);
    if (configured(source, 'internalLinksOnly', false) === true) {
      try { if (new URL(bookUrl).hostname !== new URL(sourceRoot(source)).hostname) continue; } catch (_error) { continue; }
    }
    let title = fields[offset + 1] || fields[offset + 2];
    if (!title && bookUrl) title = decodeURIComponent(bookUrl.replace(/\/$/, '').split('/').pop()).replace(/[-_]+/g, ' ');
    let cover = fields.slice(offset + 3, offset + 8).find(Boolean) || '';
    if (coverAttribute === 'style') cover = cssBackgroundUrl(cover);
    if (!bookUrl || !title) continue;
    const book = { bookKey: bookKey(source, bookUrl), sourceKey: sourceKey(source), sourceName: source.title,
      title, author: '', intro: '', coverUrl: absoluteUrl(cover, loaded.url), bookUrl,
      kind: source.adult ? '成人漫画' : '漫画', types: source.adult ? ['成人漫画'] : ['漫画'], mediaType: 'comic' };
    const existing = booksByUrl.get(bookUrl);
    if (existing) {
      if (!existing.coverUrl && book.coverUrl) existing.coverUrl = book.coverUrl;
      if (!existing.title && book.title) existing.title = book.title;
      continue;
    }
    booksByUrl.set(bookUrl, book);
    books.push(book);
  }
  if (reader.result && typeof reader.result.emit === 'function') books.forEach(book => reader.result.emit(book));
  return books;
}

async function searchBaozi(source, input) {
  const page = Math.max(1, integer(input && input.page, 1));
  const keyword = text(input && input.keyword);
  if (keyword) {
    if (page > 1) return [];
    const loaded = await fetchText({ url: `${sourceRoot(source)}search?q=${encodeURIComponent(keyword)}`,
      method: 'GET', headers: requestHeaders(sourceRoot(source)) });
    const rows = await htmlValue(loaded.body, 'div.comics-card', 'outerHTML', '', true, 100);
    const books = [];
    for (const row of rows) {
      const href = await firstAttribute(row, 'a[href]', ['href']);
      const bookUrl = absoluteUrl(href, loaded.url);
      const title = await htmlValue(row, '.comics-card__title h3', 'text', '', false, 1);
      const cover = await firstAttribute(row, 'amp-img, img', ['src', 'data-src']);
      if (bookUrl && title) books.push({ bookKey: bookKey(source, bookUrl), sourceKey: sourceKey(source),
        sourceName: source.title, title, author: '', intro: '', coverUrl: absoluteUrl(cover, loaded.url), bookUrl,
        kind: '漫画', types: ['漫画'], mediaType: 'comic' });
    }
    return books;
  }
  const filter = discoveryFilter(input);
  const region = filter.kind === 'type' ? ({ manga: 'jp', manhwa: 'kr', manhua: 'cn', comic: 'en', comics: 'en' }[filter.value] || 'all') : 'all';
  const state = filter.kind === 'state' ? (filter.value === 'completed' ? 'pub' : 'serial') : 'all';
  const tag = filter.kind === 'tag' ? filter.value : 'all';
  const url = `${sourceRoot(source)}api/bzmhq/amp_comic_list?filter=*&region=${region}` +
    `&type=${encodeURIComponent(tag)}&state=${state}&limit=36&page=${page}`;
  const payload = await fetchJsonRequest(url, sourceRoot(source));
  const rows = Array.isArray(payload && payload.items) ? payload.items : [];
  const books = rows.map(item => {

function chapterSequenceNumber(chapter) {
  const title = text(chapter && chapter.title);
  const patterns = [
    /(?:chapter|chap(?:ter)?|ch\.?|episode|ep\.?|cap[ií]tulo|epis[oó]dio|第)\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)/i,
    /([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(?:话|話|回|章|集|화|화차)/i
  ];
  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    const match = title.match(pattern);
    if (!match) continue;
    const value = Number(match[1]);
    if (Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
  }
  return null;
}

function normalizeChapterOrder(chapters) {
  if (!Array.isArray(chapters)) return [];
  const numbered = chapters.map((chapter, index) => ({ index, value: chapterSequenceNumber(chapter) }))
    .filter(item => item.value !== null);
  let ascending = 0;
  let descending = 0;
  for (let index = 1; index < numbered.length; index += 1) {
    const previous = numbered[index - 1].value;
    const current = numbered[index].value;
    if (current > previous) ascending += 1;
    else if (current < previous) descending += 1;
  }
  const comparisons = ascending + descending;
  const ordered = comparisons > 0 && descending > ascending && descending / comparisons >= 0.6
    ? chapters.slice().reverse() : chapters.slice();
  ordered.forEach((chapter, index) => { chapter.ordinal = index; });
  return ordered;
}

async function catalogUnordered(input) {
  const source = sourceForInput(input);
  const runtime = runtimeSource(source);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ZaimanhuaParser') return catalogZaimanhua(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'WeebDexParser') return catalogWeebDex(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'PizzaReaderParser') return catalogPizzaReader(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'WebtoonsParser') return catalogWebtoons(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'NhentaiParser') return catalogNhentai(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'MangaDexParser') return catalogMangaDex(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'KomiicParser') return catalogKomiic(source, input);
  const requestedUrl = text(input && (input.tocUrl || input.bookUrl)) || urlFromIdentity(input && input.bookKey);
  const root = sourceRoot(source);
  const url = absoluteUrl(requestedUrl, root);
  if (!url) throw new Error('缺少漫画目录地址');
  if (runtime.engine === 'MangaBallParser') {
    try { await Promise.resolve(reader.cookie.set('https://mangaball.net/', 'show18PlusContent=true')); } catch (_error) {}
  }
  let loaded = await fetchText({ url, method: 'GET', headers: sourceRequestHeaders(source, root) });
  if (runtime.engine === 'ZeistMangaParser') return catalogZeist(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'MangaBallParser') return catalogMangaBall(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'HotComicsParser') return catalogHotComics(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'KeyoappParser') return catalogKeyoapp(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GalleryAdultsParser') return catalogGalleryAdults(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GalleryParser') return catalogGallery(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'SinmhParser') return catalogSinmh(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GuyaParser') return catalogGuya(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'SimpleHtmlParser') return catalogSimpleHtml(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'BaoziParser') return catalogBaozi(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ComickParser') return catalogComick(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GodaParser') return catalogGoda(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ProjectSukiParser') return catalogProjectSuki(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'HComicParser') return catalogHComic(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'Mh1234Parser') return catalogMh1234(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'AcgxmhParser') return catalogAcgxmh(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'FoolSlideParser') return catalogFoolSlide(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'Manga18Parser') return catalogManga18(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GattsuParser') return catalogGattsu(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'MadthemeParser') return catalogMadtheme(source, input, loaded);
  let rows = runtime.engine === 'MangaReaderParser'
    ? await htmlValue(loaded.body, configured(source, 'selectChapter', '#chapterlist > ul > li'),
      'outerHTML', '', true, 5000)
    : runtime.engine === 'OneMangaParser'
      ? await htmlValue(loaded.body, '#All_chapters ul li a', 'outerHTML', '', true, 5000)
      : await htmlValue(loaded.body, configured(source, 'selectChapter',
        'li.wp-manga-chapter, div.wp-manga-chapter'), 'outerHTML', '', true, 5000);
  if (rows.length === 0 && runtime.engine === 'MadaraParser') {
    const postChapters = configured(source, 'postReq', false) === true;
    let chapterUrl;
    let body = '';
    if (postChapters) {
      const mangaId = await htmlValue(loaded.body, 'div#manga-chapters-holder',
        'attribute', 'data-id', false, 1);
      if (!mangaId) throw new Error('Madara 详情页没有找到章节请求标识');
      chapterUrl = `${sourceRoot(source)}wp-admin/admin-ajax.php`;
      body = `${configured(source, 'postDataReq', 'action=manga_get_chapters&manga=')}${encodeURIComponent(mangaId)}`;
    } else {
      chapterUrl = `${loaded.url.replace(/\/$/, '')}/ajax/chapters/`;
    }
    loaded = await fetchText({ url: chapterUrl, method: 'POST',
      headers: { ...requestHeaders(loaded.url), 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8' },
      body });
    rows = await chapterRows(loaded.body);
  }
  const titleSelector = runtime.engine === 'MangaReaderParser' ? '.chapternum, a' : 'a p, a';
  const fields = await htmlValues(rows.flatMap(row => [
    { html: row, selector: 'a', value: 'attribute', attribute: 'href', limit: 1 },
    { html: row, selector: titleSelector, value: 'text', limit: 1 }
  ]));
  const chapters = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index += 1) {
    const offset = index * 2;
    const href = fields[offset];
    const chapterUrl = absoluteUrl(href, loaded.url);
    if (!chapterUrl) continue;
    const title = fields[offset + 1];
    chapters.push({ chapterKey: chapterKey(source, chapterUrl), title: title || `第 ${chapters.length + 1} 话`,
      ordinal: chapters.length, chapterUrl, mediaType: 'comic' });
  }
  chapters.reverse();
  chapters.forEach((chapter, index) => { chapter.ordinal = index; });
  return chapters;
}

async function catalogMangaDex(source, input) {

    const endpoint = new URL(`https://api.mangadex.org/manga/${id}/feed`);
    const params = endpoint.searchParams;
    params.set('limit', '500');
    params.set('offset', String(offset));

    params.set('order[chapter]', 'asc');

    const payload = await fetchJsonRequest(endpoint.toString(), 'https://mangadex.org/');
    const pageRows = Array.isArray(payload && payload.data) ? payload.data : [];
    rows.push(...pageRows);
    if (rows.length >= integer(payload && payload.total, rows.length) || pageRows.length < 500) break;

  const chapters = rows.filter(row => !text(row && row.attributes && row.attributes.externalUrl)).map((row, index) => {

    const chapterUrl = `https://mangadex.org/chapter/${chapterId}`;
    return chapterId ? { chapterKey: chapterKey(source, chapterUrl), title, ordinal: index, chapterUrl, mediaType: 'comic' } : null;

}

async function catalogKomiic(source, input) {

  const data = await komiicGraphql(source, query, 'chaptersByComicId', { comicId: id });
  const rows = Array.isArray(data.chaptersByComicId) ? data.chaptersByComicId : [];
  const chapters = rows.map((row, index) => {
    const chapterId = text(row && row.id);
    if (!chapterId) return null;
    const serial = text(row && row.serial) || String(index + 1);
    const chapterUrl = `${sourceRoot(source)}comic/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/chapter/${encodeURIComponent(chapterId)}/images/all`;

async function catalogSimpleHtml(source, input, loaded) {
  const chapterSelector = text(runtimeConfig(source).chapterSelector);
  if (chapterSelector) {
    let chapterPage = loaded;
    let rows = await htmlValue(chapterPage.body, chapterSelector, 'outerHTML', '', true, 5000);
    const seedSelector = text(runtimeConfig(source).chapterSeedSelector);
    if (rows.length === 0 && seedSelector) {
      const seedHref = await firstAttribute(loaded.body, seedSelector, ['href']);
      const seedUrl = absoluteUrl(seedHref, loaded.url);
      if (seedUrl) {
        chapterPage = await fetchText({ url: seedUrl, method: 'GET', headers: sourceRequestHeaders(source, loaded.url) });
        rows = await htmlValue(chapterPage.body, chapterSelector, 'outerHTML', '', true, 5000);
      }
    }
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      const requestedPath = (() => {
        try { return new URL(loaded.url).pathname.replace(/\/$/, ''); } catch (_error) { return ''; }
      })();
      if (requestedPath) rows = await htmlValue(loaded.body,
        `a[href*="${requestedPath.replace(/"/g, '\\"')}/chapter-"]`, 'outerHTML', '', true, 5000);
    }
    const chapterLinkSelector = configured(source, 'chapterLinkSelector', 'a[href]');
    const chapterTitleSelector = configured(source, 'chapterTitleSelector', 'a[href]');
    const fields = await htmlValues(rows.flatMap(row => [
      { html: row, selector: chapterLinkSelector, value: 'attribute', attribute: 'href', limit: 1 },
      { html: row, selector: chapterTitleSelector, value: 'text', limit: 1 }
    ]));
    const chapters = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index += 1) {
      const offset = index * 2;
      const href = fields[offset];
      const chapterUrl = absoluteUrl(href, chapterPage.url);
      if (!chapterUrl) continue;
      const title = fields[offset + 1];
      chapters.push({ chapterKey: chapterKey(source, chapterUrl), title: title || `第 ${chapters.length + 1} 话`,
        ordinal: chapters.length, chapterUrl, mediaType: 'comic' });
    }
    if (configured(source, 'reverseChapters', false) === true) chapters.reverse();
    chapters.forEach((chapter, index) => { chapter.ordinal = index; });
    return chapters;
  }
  const title = await selectedTextOrAttribute(loaded.body,
    configured(source, 'detailTitleSelector', 'h1'), configured(source, 'detailTitleAttribute', '')) ||
    text(input && input.title) || '全本';
  return [{ chapterKey: chapterKey(source, loaded.url), title, ordinal: 0,
    chapterUrl: loaded.url, mediaType: 'comic' }];
}

async function catalogZaimanhua(source, input) {

  const id = (detail.bookUrl.match(/comic\/detail\/([^?]+)/) || [])[1] || '';
  if (!id) throw new Error('再漫画目录缺少作品 ID');
  const payload = await fetchJsonRequest(detail.bookUrl, sourceRoot(source));
  const item = zaimanhuaData(payload);
  const chapters = [];
  const groups = Array.isArray(item.chapters) ? item.chapters : [];
  for (const group of groups) {
    const rows = Array.isArray(group && group.data) ? group.data :
      Array.isArray(group && group.chapter_list) ? group.chapter_list : [];
    for (const chapter of rows.slice().reverse()) {
      const chapterId = text(chapter && (chapter.chapter_id || chapter.id));
      if (!chapterId) continue;
      const chapterUrl = `${sourceRoot(source)}app/v1/comic/chapter/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${encodeURIComponent(chapterId)}`;
      chapters.push({ chapterKey: chapterKey(source, chapterUrl),
        title: text(chapter && (chapter.chapter_title || chapter.title)) || `第 ${chapters.length + 1} 话`,
        ordinal: chapters.length, chapterUrl, mediaType: 'comic' });
    }
  }
  const objectGroups = !Array.isArray(item.chapters) ? object(item.chapters) : {};
  for (const rowsValue of Object.values(objectGroups)) {
    const rows = Array.isArray(rowsValue) ? rowsValue : [];
    for (const chapter of rows.slice().reverse()) {
      const chapterId = text(chapter && (chapter.chapter_id || chapter.id));
      if (!chapterId) continue;
      const chapterUrl = `${sourceRoot(source)}app/v1/comic/chapter/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${encodeURIComponent(chapterId)}`;
      chapters.push({ chapterKey: chapterKey(source, chapterUrl),
        title: text(chapter && (chapter.chapter_title || chapter.title)) || `第 ${chapters.length + 1} 话`,
        ordinal: chapters.length, chapterUrl, mediaType: 'comic' });
    }
  }
  return chapters;
}

}

async function catalogManga18(source, input, loaded) {
  const rows = await htmlValue(loaded.body,
    configured(source, 'selectChapter', 'div.chapter_box li'), 'outerHTML', '', true, 5000);
  const fields = await htmlValues(rows.flatMap(row => [
    { html: row, selector: 'a', value: 'attribute', attribute: 'href', limit: 1 },
    { html: row, selector: 'a', value: 'text', limit: 1 }
  ]));
  const chapters = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index += 1) {
    const offset = index * 2;
    const href = fields[offset];
    const chapterUrl = absoluteUrl(href, loaded.url);
    if (!chapterUrl) continue;
    const title = fields[offset + 1];
    chapters.push({ chapterKey: chapterKey(source, chapterUrl), title: title || `Chapter ${chapters.length + 1}`,
      ordinal: chapters.length, chapterUrl, mediaType: 'comic' });
  }
  chapters.reverse();
  chapters.forEach((chapter, index) => { chapter.ordinal = index; });
  return chapters;
}

async function catalogMadtheme(source, input, loaded) {
  const scripts = await htmlValue(loaded.body, 'script:containsData(bookSlug), script', 'html', '', true, 1000);
  let slug = '';
  for (const script of scripts) {
    const match = script.match(/bookSlug\s*=\s*["']([^"']+)["']/);
    if (match) { slug = match[1]; break; }
  }
  if (!slug) throw new Error('Madtheme 详情页没有找到作品标识');
  const chapterDoc = await fetchText({ url: `${sourceRoot(source)}api/manga/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/chapters?source=detail`,
    method: 'GET', headers: requestHeaders(loaded.url) });
  const rows = await htmlValue(chapterDoc.body, configured(source, 'selectChapter', 'ul#chapter-list li'),
    'outerHTML', '', true, 5000);
  const chapters = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const href = await firstAttribute(row, 'a', ['href']);
    const chapterUrl = absoluteUrl(href, chapterDoc.url);
    if (!chapterUrl) continue;
    const title = await htmlValue(row, '.chapter-title, a', 'text', '', false, 1);
    const date = await htmlValue(row, configured(source, 'selectDate', 'div .chapter-update'),
      'text', '', false, 1);
    chapters.push({ chapterKey: chapterKey(source, chapterUrl), title: title || `Chapter ${chapters.length + 1}`,
      ordinal: chapters.length, chapterUrl, mediaType: 'comic' });
  }
  chapters.reverse();
  chapters.forEach((chapter, index) => { chapter.ordinal = index; });
  return chapters;
}

  if (runtime.engine === 'PizzaReaderParser') return contentPizzaReader(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GuyaParser') return contentGuya(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'SimpleHtmlParser') return contentSimpleHtml(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'BaoziParser') return contentBaozi(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ComickParser') return contentComick(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ZaimanhuaParser') return contentZaimanhua(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'NhentaiParser') return contentNhentai(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GodaParser') return contentGoda(source, input);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ProjectSukiParser') return contentProjectSuki(source, input);

  const root = sourceRoot(source);
  const url = absoluteUrl(requestedUrl, root);
  if (!url) throw new Error('缺少漫画章节地址');
  if (runtime.engine === 'MangaBallParser') {
    try { await Promise.resolve(reader.cookie.set('https://mangaball.net/', 'show18PlusContent=true')); } catch (_error) {}
  }
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url, method: 'GET',
    headers: runtime.engine === 'WebtoonsParser' ? webtoonsHeaders(url) : sourceRequestHeaders(source, root) });
  if (runtime.engine === 'MangaReaderParser') return contentMangaReader(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'OneMangaParser') return contentOneManga(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'ZeistMangaParser') return contentZeist(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'MangaBallParser') return contentMangaBall(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'HotComicsParser') return contentHotComics(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'WebtoonsParser') return contentWebtoons(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'KeyoappParser') return contentKeyoapp(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GalleryAdultsParser') return contentGalleryAdults(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GalleryParser') return contentGallery(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'SinmhParser') return contentSinmh(source, input, loaded);

  if (runtime.engine === 'Manga18Parser') return contentManga18(source, input, loaded);
  if (runtime.engine === 'GattsuParser') return contentGattsu(source, input, loaded);

      'outerHTML', '', true, 256);

    images = await htmlValue(loaded.body, 'div.reading-content img', 'outerHTML', '', true, 256);
  }

    const raw = await firstAttribute(image, 'img', ['data-src', 'data-lazy-src', 'data-original', 'src']);

  };

async function contentSinmh(source, input, loaded) {
  const scripts = await htmlValue(loaded.body,
    configured(source, 'selectTestScript', 'script:containsData(chapterImages = )'), 'html', '', true, 1000);
  let rawImages = [];
  let imagePath = '';
  for (const script of scripts) {
    const array = script.match(/chapterImages\s*=\s*\[([\s\S]*?)\]\s*;/);
    if (array) rawImages = [...array[1].matchAll(/["']([^"']+)["']/g)].map(match => match[1]);
    const path = script.match(/chapterPath\s*=\s*["']([^"']*)/);
    if (path) imagePath = path[1];
    if (rawImages.length) break;
  }
  if (rawImages.length === 0) throw new Error('SinMH 章节没有找到图片清单');
  let imageHost = sourceRoot(source).replace(/\/$/, '');
  try {
    const config = await fetchText({ url: absoluteUrl('/js/config.js', sourceRoot(source)), method: 'GET',
      headers: requestHeaders(loaded.url) });
    const hostMatch = config.body.match(/domain["']?\s*:\s*\[\s*["']([^"']+)/);
    if (hostMatch) imageHost = hostMatch[1].replace(/\\/g, '').replace(/^http:/i, 'https:').replace(/\/$/, '');
  } catch (_error) {}
  const urls = rawImages.map(raw => {
    const cleaned = raw.replace(/\\\//g, '/').replace(/^http:/i, 'https:');
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(cleaned)) return cleaned;
    if (cleaned.startsWith('/')) return `${imageHost}${cleaned}`;
    return `${imageHost}/${imagePath}${cleaned}`;
  }).filter(Boolean);
  return { contentType: 'structured', content: '', mediaUrl: urls[0], mediaUrls: urls,
    mediaHeaders: requestHeaders(loaded.url), baseUrl: loaded.url, title: text(input && input.title),
    imageStyle: 'width:100%;height:auto;display:block;', message: '' };
}

async function contentGuya(source, input) {
  const chapterUrl = text(input && input.chapterUrl) || urlFromIdentity(input && input.chapterKey);
  const clean = absoluteUrl(chapterUrl, sourceRoot(source)).replace(/\/$/, '');
  const key = clean.split('/').pop();
  const seriesUrl = clean.substring(0, clean.lastIndexOf('/'));
  const slug = seriesUrl.split('/').pop();
  const loaded = await fetchText({ url: seriesUrl, method: 'GET', headers: requestHeaders(seriesUrl) });
  const payload = object(JSON.parse(loaded.body || '{}'));
  const chapter = object(object(payload.chapters)[key]);
  const groups = object(chapter.groups);
  const groupName = Object.keys(groups)[0];
  const pages = Array.isArray(groups[groupName]) ? groups[groupName] : [];
  const folder = text(chapter.folder);
  const urls = pages.map(name => {
    const rawName = text(name);
    const queryAt = rawName.indexOf('?');
    const fileName = queryAt >= 0 ? rawName.slice(0, queryAt) : rawName;
    const query = queryAt >= 0 ? rawName.slice(queryAt) : '';
    return `${sourceRoot(source)}media/manga/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/chapters/` +
      `${encodeURIComponent(folder)}/${encodeURIComponent(groupName)}/${encodeURIComponent(fileName)}${query}`;
  });
  if (urls.length === 0) throw new Error('Guya 章节没有找到漫画图片');
  return { contentType: 'structured', content: '', mediaUrl: urls[0], mediaUrls: urls,
    mediaHeaders: requestHeaders(seriesUrl), baseUrl: seriesUrl, title: text(input && input.title),
    imageStyle: 'width:100%;height:auto;display:block;', message: '' };
}

async function contentSimpleHtml(source, input) {
  const requested = text(input && input.chapterUrl) || urlFromIdentity(input && input.chapterKey);
  let url = absoluteUrl(requested, sourceRoot(source));
  const replaceFrom = text(runtimeConfig(source).contentPathReplaceFrom);
  if (replaceFrom) url = url.replace(replaceFrom, text(runtimeConfig(source).contentPathReplaceTo));
  const headers = sourceRequestHeaders(source, url);
  const first = await fetchText({ url, method: 'GET', headers });
  const pageBodies = [first];
  const paginationSelector = text(runtimeConfig(source).paginationSelector);
  if (paginationSelector) {
    const links = await htmlValue(first.body, paginationSelector, 'outerHTML', '', true, 256);
    const urls = [];
    for (const link of links) {
      const href = await firstAttribute(link, 'a', ['href']);
      const pageUrl = absoluteUrl(href, first.url);
      if (pageUrl && pageUrl !== first.url && !urls.includes(pageUrl)) urls.push(pageUrl);
    }
    for (const pageUrl of urls) {
      try { pageBodies.push(await fetchText({ url: pageUrl, method: 'GET', headers: sourceRequestHeaders(source, first.url) })); }
      catch (_error) {}
    }
  }
  const selector = configured(source, 'contentSelector', 'article img');
  const attributes = Array.isArray(runtimeConfig(source).contentAttributes)
    ? runtimeConfig(source).contentAttributes : ['data-full', 'data-large_image', 'data-src', 'data-original', 'src', 'href'];
  const urls = [];
  for (const page of pageBodies) {
    const images = await htmlValue(page.body, selector, 'outerHTML', '', true, 256);
    const imageFields = await htmlValues(images.flatMap(image => attributes.map(attribute => ({
      html: image, selector: 'img, amp-img, a', value: 'attribute', attribute, limit: 1
    }))));
    for (let index = 0; index < images.length; index += 1) {
      const raw = imageFields.slice(index * attributes.length, (index + 1) * attributes.length).find(Boolean) || '';
      let imageUrl = absoluteUrl(raw, page.url);
      const removePaths = Array.isArray(runtimeConfig(source).removeImagePaths)
        ? runtimeConfig(source).removeImagePaths : [text(runtimeConfig(source).removeImagePath)];
      for (const removePath of removePaths.map(text).filter(Boolean)) imageUrl = imageUrl.replace(removePath, '');
      if (removePaths.some(item => text(item))) imageUrl = imageUrl.split('?')[0];
      if (!imageUrl || /^data:/i.test(imageUrl) || urls.includes(imageUrl)) continue;
      if (/\.(?:jpe?g|png|webp|avif|gif)(?:[?#]|$)/i.test(imageUrl)) urls.push(imageUrl);
    }
    if (urls.length === 0 && text(runtimeConfig(source).contentRawParentClass)) {
      const className = text(runtimeConfig(source).contentRawParentClass).replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi, '');
      const expression = new RegExp(`<[^>]+class=["'][^"']*\\b${className}\\b[^"']*["'][^>]*>[\\s\\S]{0,1500}?<img\\b[^>]*>`, 'gi');
      for (const fragment of text(page.body).match(expression) || []) {
        const raw = htmlAttribute(fragment, 'data-src') || htmlAttribute(fragment, 'data-original') ||
          htmlAttribute(fragment, 'src');
        let imageUrl = absoluteUrl(raw, page.url);
        const removePaths = Array.isArray(runtimeConfig(source).removeImagePaths)
          ? runtimeConfig(source).removeImagePaths : [text(runtimeConfig(source).removeImagePath)];
        for (const removePath of removePaths.map(text).filter(Boolean)) imageUrl = imageUrl.replace(removePath, '');
        imageUrl = imageUrl.split('?')[0];
        if (imageUrl && !urls.includes(imageUrl) && /\.(?:jpe?g|png|webp|avif|gif)$/i.test(imageUrl)) urls.push(imageUrl);
      }
    }
    if (configured(source, 'contentRawProtocolImages', false) === true) {
      const excluded = Array.isArray(runtimeConfig(source).removeImageContains)
        ? runtimeConfig(source).removeImageContains.map(text).filter(Boolean) : [];
      const expression = /(?:https?:)?\/\/[^"'\\\s]+\.(?:jpe?g|png|webp|avif|gif)(?:\?[^"'\\\s]*)?/gi;
      for (const raw of text(page.body).match(expression) || []) {
        const imageUrl = absoluteUrl(raw.replace(/\\\//g, '/'), page.url);
        if (!imageUrl || excluded.some(value => imageUrl.includes(value)) || urls.includes(imageUrl)) continue;
        urls.push(imageUrl);
      }
    }
  }
  if (configured(source, 'reversePages', false) === true) urls.reverse();
  if (urls.length === 0) throw new Error('图集章节没有找到漫画图片');
  return { contentType: 'structured', content: '', mediaUrl: urls[0], mediaUrls: urls,
    mediaHeaders: sourceRequestHeaders(source, first.url), baseUrl: first.url, title: text(input && input.title),
    imageStyle: 'width:100%;height:auto;display:block;', message: '' };
}

async function contentBaozi(source, input) {
  let nextUrl = absoluteUrl(text(input && input.chapterUrl) || urlFromIdentity(input && input.chapterKey), sourceRoot(source));
  const seenPages = new Set();
  const urls = [];
  for (let part = 0; nextUrl && part < 30 && !seenPages.has(nextUrl); part += 1) {
    seenPages.add(nextUrl);
    const loaded = await fetchText({ url: nextUrl, method: 'GET', headers: requestHeaders(nextUrl) });
    const buttons = await htmlValue(loaded.body, '#__nuxt button.pure-button', 'outerHTML', '', true, 256);
    for (const button of buttons) {
      const on = await firstAttribute(button, 'button', ['on', 'onclick']);
      const match = on.match(/:\s*['"]([^'"]+)/);
      const imageUrl = match ? absoluteUrl(match[1].split('?t=')[0], loaded.url)
        .replace(/^https:\/\/s\d+\.bzcdn\.net\//i, 'https://static-tw.baozimh.com/') : '';
      if (imageUrl && !urls.includes(imageUrl)) urls.push(imageUrl);
    }
    const href = await firstAttribute(loaded.body, 'a#next-chapter', ['href']);
    const candidate = absoluteUrl(href, loaded.url);
    const currentPart = loaded.url.replace(/\/$/, '').split('/').pop().replace(/\.html.*$/, '');
    const nextPart = candidate.replace(/\/$/, '').split('/').pop().replace(/\.html.*$/, '');
    const base = currentPart.replace(/_\d+$/, '');
    if (!candidate || !nextPart.startsWith(`${base}_`) || candidate === nextUrl) break;
    nextUrl = candidate;
  }
  if (urls.length === 0) throw new Error('包子漫画章节没有找到漫画图片');
  return { contentType: 'structured', content: '', mediaUrl: urls[0], mediaUrls: urls,
    mediaHeaders: requestHeaders(nextUrl), baseUrl: nextUrl, title: text(input && input.title),
    imageStyle: 'width:100%;height:auto;display:block;', message: '' };
}

    baseUrl: requestedUrl, title: text(input && input.title),
    imageStyle: 'width:100%;height:auto;display:block;', message: '' };
}

function decodeGodaImages(encoded) {
  const prefix = 'J7r';
  const marker = 'kD';
  const signature = 'W4s';
  const suffix = 'nQ';
  const sourceAlphabet = '_-9876543210abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
  const base64UrlAlphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_';
  const value = text(encoded);
  if (!value.startsWith(prefix) || !value.endsWith(suffix)) return [];
  const payload = value.slice(prefix.length, -suffix.length);
  const contentLength = payload.length - marker.length - signature.length;
  if (contentLength < 0) return [];
  const tailLength = Math.floor(contentLength / 3);
  const headLength = Math.floor((contentLength - tailLength) / 2);
  const middleLength = contentLength - headLength - tailLength;
  const markerStart = headLength;
  const middleStart = markerStart + marker.length;
  const signatureStart = middleStart + middleLength;
  if (payload.slice(markerStart, middleStart) !== marker ||
      payload.slice(signatureStart, signatureStart + signature.length) !== signature) return [];
  const head = payload.slice(0, headLength);
  const middle = payload.slice(middleStart, signatureStart);
  const tail = payload.slice(signatureStart + signature.length);
  if (tail.length !== tailLength) return [];
  const shuffled = tail + head + middle;
  let substituted = '';
  for (let offset = 0, chunk = 0; offset < shuffled.length; offset += 7, chunk += 1) {
    const part = shuffled.slice(offset, offset + 7);
    substituted += chunk % 2 === 1 ? part.split('').reverse().join('') : part;
  }
  let base64Url = '';
  for (const char of substituted) {
    const index = sourceAlphabet.indexOf(char);
    if (index < 0) return [];
    base64Url += base64UrlAlphabet[index];
  }

  const configuredImageSelector = configured(source, 'idImg', 'gimg');
  const imageSelector = /^[.#\[]/.test(configuredImageSelector) ? configuredImageSelector : `#${configuredImageSelector}`;
  const imageFields = await htmlValues(pages.flatMap(page => [
    { html: text(page.body), selector: imageSelector, value: 'attribute', attribute: 'data-src', limit: 1 },
    { html: text(page.body), selector: imageSelector, value: 'attribute', attribute: 'data-lazy-src', limit: 1 },
    { html: text(page.body), selector: imageSelector, value: 'attribute', attribute: 'src', limit: 1 }
  ]));
  for (let index = 0; index < pages.length; index += 1) {
    const page = pages[index];
    const raw = imageFields.slice(index * 3, index * 3 + 3).find(Boolean) || '';
    const url = absoluteUrl(raw, text(page.url) || requests[index].url);
    if (url && !urls.includes(url)) urls.push(url);
  }
  if (urls.length === 0) throw new Error('成人图库章节没有返回漫画图片');
  return {
    contentType: 'structured', content: '', mediaUrl: urls[0], mediaUrls: urls,
    mediaHeaders: requestHeaders(loaded.url), baseUrl: loaded.url,
    title: text(input && input.title), imageStyle: 'width:100%;height:auto;display:block;', message: ''
  };
}

async function contentFoolSlide(source, input, loaded) {
  const scripts = await htmlValue(loaded.body, 'script', 'html', '', true, 1000);
  let pages = [];
  for (const script of scripts) {
    const match = script.match(/var\s+pages\s*=\s*(\[[\s\S]*?\])\s*;/);
    if (!match) continue;
    try { pages = JSON.parse(match[1]); } catch (_error) {}
    if (pages.length) break;
  }
  const urls = pages.map(page => absoluteUrl(page && page.url, loaded.url)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 256);
  if (urls.length === 0) throw new Error('FoolSlide 章节没有返回漫画图片');
  return { contentType: 'structured', content: '', mediaUrl: urls[0], mediaUrls: urls,
    mediaHeaders: requestHeaders(loaded.url), baseUrl: loaded.url, title: text(input && input.title),
    imageStyle: 'width:100%;height:auto;display:block;', message: '' };
}

function decodeBase64Ascii(value) {
  if (typeof atob === 'function') return atob(value);
  const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';
  const clean = text(value).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]/g, '');
  let output = '';
  let bits = 0;
  let bitCount = 0;
  for (const char of clean) {
    if (char === '=') break;
    const index = alphabet.indexOf(char);
    if (index < 0) continue;
    bits = (bits << 6) | index;
    bitCount += 6;
    if (bitCount >= 8) {
      bitCount -= 8;
      output += String.fromCharCode((bits >> bitCount) & 255);
    }
  }
  return output;
}

async function contentManga18(source, input, loaded) {
  const scripts = await htmlValue(loaded.body, 'script:containsData(slides_p_path), script',
    'html', '', true, 1000);
  let encoded = [];
  for (const script of scripts) {
    const match = script.match(/slides_p_path\s*=\s*\[([\s\S]*?)\]/);
    if (!match) continue;
    encoded = [...match[1].matchAll(/["']([^"']+)["']/g)].map(item => item[1]);
    if (encoded.length) break;
  }
  const urls = encoded.map(item => absoluteUrl(decodeBase64Ascii(item), loaded.url)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 256);
  if (urls.length === 0) throw new Error('Manga18 章节没有返回漫画图片');
  return { contentType: 'structured', content: '', mediaUrl: urls[0], mediaUrls: urls,
    mediaHeaders: requestHeaders(loaded.url), baseUrl: loaded.url, title: text(input && input.title),
    imageStyle: 'width:100%;height:auto;display:block;', message: '' };
}

async function contentGattsu(source, input, loaded) {
  const totalText = await htmlValue(loaded.body, 'div.galeria-paginacao span', 'text', '', false, 1);
  const totalMatch = totalText.match(/-\s*(\d+)\s*\)?\s*$/) || totalText.match(/(\d+)(?!.*\d)/);
  const total = Math.max(1, Math.min(256, integer(totalMatch && totalMatch[1], 1)));
  const rawUrl = loaded.url.includes('=') ? loaded.url.slice(0, loaded.url.lastIndexOf('=')) : loaded.url;
  const urls = [];
  for (let index = 1; index <= total; index += 1) {
    const pageUrl = `${rawUrl}=${index}`;
    const page = index === 1 && pageUrl === loaded.url ? loaded :
      await fetchText({ url: pageUrl, method: 'GET', headers: requestHeaders(loaded.url) });
    const raw = await firstAttribute(page.body, 'div.galeria-foto img', ['data-src', 'src']);
    const imageUrl = absoluteUrl(raw, page.url);
    if (imageUrl && !urls.includes(imageUrl)) urls.push(imageUrl);
  }
  if (urls.length === 0) throw new Error('Gattsu 章节没有返回漫画图片');
  return { contentType: 'structured', content: '', mediaUrl: urls[0], mediaUrls: urls,
    mediaHeaders: requestHeaders(loaded.url), baseUrl: loaded.url, title: text(input && input.title),
    imageStyle: 'width:100%;height:auto;display:block;', message: '' };
}

async function contentMadtheme(source, input, loaded) {
  const images = await htmlValue(loaded.body, configured(source, 'selectPage', 'div#chapter-images img'),
    'outerHTML', '', true, 256);
  const urls = [];
  for (const image of images) {
    const primary = await firstAttribute(image, 'img', ['data-src', 'data-lazy-src', 'src']);
    const onerror = await firstAttribute(image, 'img', ['onerror']);
    const fallback = text(onerror).match(/this\.src=['"]([^'"]+)/);
    const raw = primary.includes('://s20.') && fallback ? fallback[1] : primary;
    const imageUrl = absoluteUrl(raw, loaded.url);
    if (imageUrl && !urls.includes(imageUrl)) urls.push(imageUrl);
  }
  const scripts = await htmlValue(loaded.body, 'script', 'html', '', true, 1000);
  let mainServer = '';
  let chapterImages = [];
  for (const script of scripts) {
    const serverMatch = script.match(/mainServer\s*=\s*["']([^"']+)/);
    if (serverMatch) mainServer = serverMatch[1].startsWith('//') ? `https:${serverMatch[1]}` : serverMatch[1];
    const imagesMatch = script.match(/chapImages\s*=\s*["']([^"']*)["']/);
    if (imagesMatch) chapterImages = imagesMatch[1].split(',').map(text).filter(Boolean);
  }
  for (const raw of chapterImages) {
    const imageUrl = absoluteUrl(mainServer ? `${mainServer.replace(/\/$/, '')}/${raw.replace(/^\//, '')}` : raw,
      loaded.url);
    if (imageUrl && !urls.includes(imageUrl)) urls.push(imageUrl);
  }
  if (urls.length === 0) throw new Error('Madtheme 章节没有返回漫画图片');
  return { contentType: 'structured', content: '', mediaUrl: urls[0], mediaUrls: urls.slice(0, 256),
    mediaHeaders: requestHeaders(loaded.url), baseUrl: loaded.url, title: text(input && input.title),
    imageStyle: 'width:100%;height:auto;display:block;', message: '' };
}

function bytesToBase64(value) {
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
  const bytes = value instanceof Uint8Array ? value : new Uint8Array(value || []);
  let binary = '';
  for (let index = 0; index < bytes.length; index += 1) binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[index]);
  if (typeof btoa === 'function') return btoa(binary);
  throw new Error('宿主没有提供二进制 Base64 编码能力');
}

function imageBytes(value, dataBase64) {
  if (value instanceof Uint8Array) return value;
  if (value && typeof value === 'object' && ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) {
    return new Uint8Array(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, value.byteLength);
  }
  if (dataBase64 && typeof atob === 'function') {
    const decoded = atob(dataBase64.slice(0, 32));
    return Uint8Array.from(decoded, character => character.charCodeAt(0));
  }
  return new Uint8Array();
}

function sniffImageContentType(value, dataBase64, declared) {
  const normalized = text(declared).toLowerCase();
  if (normalized.startsWith('image/')) return declared;
  const bytes = imageBytes(value, dataBase64);
  if (bytes.length >= 3 && bytes[0] === 0xff && bytes[1] === 0xd8 && bytes[2] === 0xff) return 'image/jpeg';
  if (bytes.length >= 8 && bytes[0] === 0x89 && bytes[1] === 0x50 && bytes[2] === 0x4e && bytes[3] === 0x47) return 'image/png';
  if (bytes.length >= 6 && bytes[0] === 0x47 && bytes[1] === 0x49 && bytes[2] === 0x46 && bytes[3] === 0x38) return 'image/gif';
  if (bytes.length >= 12 && bytes[0] === 0x52 && bytes[1] === 0x49 && bytes[2] === 0x46 && bytes[3] === 0x46 &&
    bytes[8] === 0x57 && bytes[9] === 0x45 && bytes[10] === 0x42 && bytes[11] === 0x50) return 'image/webp';
  if (bytes.length >= 12 && bytes[4] === 0x66 && bytes[5] === 0x74 && bytes[6] === 0x79 && bytes[7] === 0x70) {
    const brand = String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(8, 12));
    if (brand === 'avif' || brand === 'avis') return 'image/avif';
  }
  return normalized && normalized !== 'application/octet-stream' ? declared : 'image/jpeg';
}

async function image(input) {
  const source = sourceForInput(input);
  const runtime = runtimeSource(source);
  const url = text(input && (input.url || input.src));
  if (!url) throw new Error('图片地址为空');
  let referer = text(input && (input.chapterUrl || input.bookUrl)) || sourceRoot(source);
  if (configured(source, 'imageRefererMode', '') === 'image-origin') {
    try { referer = `${new URL(url).origin}/`; } catch (_error) {}
  }
  const response = await reader.http.fetch({ url, method: 'GET', headers: sourceRequestHeaders(source, referer),
    responseType: 'bytes', timeoutMs: 30000 });
  const status = integer(response && response.status, 0);
  if (status < 200 || status >= 400) throw new Error(`图片请求失败：HTTP ${status || 'unknown'}`);
  const headers = object(response && response.headers);
  const contentTypeName = Object.keys(headers).find(name => name.toLowerCase() === 'content-type');
  const rawData = response && (response.data || response.body);
  const dataBase64 = text(response && response.bodyBase64) || bytesToBase64(rawData);
  return { dataBase64, contentType: sniffImageContentType(rawData, dataBase64,
    text(contentTypeName ? headers[contentTypeName] : '')) };
}

module.exports = { searchTargets, permissionGroups, search, exploreMenu, explore,
  detail, catalog, content, image };
